title: Dashboard api <-> host agent, protocol version 1
description: JSON lines over the agent's unix socket (mode 0660, group casino-agent). The agent first checks the peer's uid/gid against its allowlist. Each request line is at most 65536 bytes; mac is HMAC-SHA256 with the shared agent token over the canonical JSON of the other request fields (sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', ASCII escapes); ts is epoch milliseconds and must be within 30 s of the agent's clock; each id is accepted once. A connection idle for 5 s is closed. A command that runs past its timeout is killed and answered with timeout. Failures carry only a generic code, and the agent closes the connection after bad_request, unauthorized, replayed, too_large and busy. Long-running commands run as jobs: job.start {cmd, args} -> {job_id}; job.get / job.cancel {job_id} -> {job_id, cmd, status, exit_code, started_ms, duration_ms, lines}; job.stream {job_id, from_seq} -> frames, then that body; job.audit {after, limit} -> {records, next}. One mutating job per service: a second mutating job or command gets busy; an unknown job id gets not_found. An export job's summary carries file_id once its file is registered; file.read {file_id} streams the file as chunk messages, then {file_id, name, bytes, sha256}. Files expire after 1 h; an unknown, expired or altered file gets not_found. Host paths never appear: export job lines show <export> in their place. The owner terminal is one PTY session at a time: pty.open {cols 1-500, rows 1-200} -> {session_id} (a second open gets busy); pty.stream {session_id, from_seq} -> chunk messages of at most 16 KiB of output, at most one per 20 ms, where seq is the last chunk in the message (resume from seq + 1), then the summary; pty.write {session_id, data: base64 of at most 16 KiB} -> {}; pty.resize {session_id, cols, rows} -> {cols, rows}; pty.close {session_id} -> {session_id, reason, started_ms, duration_ms}. A session ends after 10 min without input or resize, after 60 min, when the shell exits or when its recording is full (reason idle, max, exited, recording_full, closed or shutdown); a closed session gets not_found. Input and output are recorded as asciicast v2 named by session_id; pty.recording {session_id} streams that file as chunk messages of at most 64 KiB, then {session_id, bytes} (an unknown id gets not_found). job.audit carries pty.open and pty.close records.

id.description: The request's id; null when the request could not be read.

frame.description: One job output line, sent only in answer to job.stream, before its final reply. seq rises by one per line within a job; a gap means old lines left the 5000-line buffer.

line.description: At most 8 KiB, ANSI and control characters removed; a cut line ends with ' [truncated]'.

chunk.description: One piece of an export file, sent only in answer to file.read, before its final reply {file_id, name, bytes, sha256}. A chunk line is up to about 88 KiB, so readers need a line limit above that.

data.description: Up to 64 KiB of the file, base64.
